svg.aria-label: Use the weights to mix the value rows
svg.title: Use the weights to mix the value rows
svg.text: Keep the source order aligned: CLS, P1, …, P196 in both A and V.

g.text: h(CLS) = a(CLS, CLS) v(CLS) + … + a(CLS, P196) v(P196)

svg.text: Q and K choose the weights. V supplies the features carried into each message.
